QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_12

question.text: Hurdle rates in the Indian AIF industry typically range between:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 6.1.2, Indian AIF hurdle rates range 10-12% p.a. (higher than international 7-8% benchmarks given ~12% long-term equity returns). The Trap: 7-8% is international hurdle; 4-6% is too low; 20% is not typical. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with long-term BSE 10-yr average equity returns. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Benchmark proposed hurdles against 10-12% local range when advising on a new launch.
